entities.name: Ondřej Balvín
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ondřej Balvín is a Czech professional basketball who last played for the Hong Kong Bulls of the National Basketball League (NBL). Standing at 7 ft 1.5 in (2.17 m), he plays at the center position. As well as Latvia, Balvin has played club basketball in the Czech Republic, Spain, Germany, and Japan.
